mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDP growth is positive, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over three months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real GDP signals a broad-based economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both increase in the same month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both proxies increase, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with an increase in consumer price index signals inflationary pressures, which erodes real returns and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases in the same month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail and food services sales signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS increases, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
